news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹10.79 (vs ₹26.17 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹10.79 (down from ₹26.17 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹1.14b (down 39% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹32.4m (down 59% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.8% (down from 4.2% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 1% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 120% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 24% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 89% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings have declined by 2.8% per year over the past 5 years. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are declining over an extended period, then in most cases the share price will decline over time unless the company can turn around its fortunes. A trend of falling earnings can be very difficult to turn around. If the company is well already established it may also be a sign the company has matured and is in decline. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns. news.title: Aditya Himmat Bhansali entered into Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 72.70% stake in P.H. Capital Limited (BSE:500143) from a group of sellers for INR 450 million.
news.body:
Aditya Himmat Bhansali entered into Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 72.70% stake in P.H. Capital Limited (BSE:500143) from a group of sellers for INR 450 million on December 20, 2025. A cash consideration of INR 450.77 million valued at INR 206.66 per share will be paid by the buyer. As part of consideration, INR 450.77 million is paid towards common equity of P.H. Capital Limited. In a related transaction Aditya Himmat Bhansal proposed to acquire 26% stake in P.H. Capital Limited (BSE:500143) for approximately INR 160 million on December 20, 2025. 

The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee and subject to statutory approval.
